name: xhostd
line: Runs static sites, apps and APIs with managed Postgres.

free.text: Free Basic, no card: 3 channels, 128 MiB RAM, 500 MiB DB, 2 GB objects

work.math: Basic static delivery is $0 a month within 3 channels, 0.1 CPU and 128 MiB, and 2 GB objects. 1 million requests and 100 GB have no listed charge. The 100-minute build needs unpriced outside tools or custom Docker.

$20 a month before tax. Indie has a soft limit of 1 core and 2 GiB for 730 hours, with no listed fee for requests or data sent out. 1M requests and 100 GB add no listed charge. CPU throughput and build limits: untested.

Studio plan at $40 a month before tax is a possible option: 40 GB database and 7-day backups. But database memory is only 'up to 1,088 MB', not a guaranteed 1 GiB. Internal 10 GB traffic price and fit are not verified.
